services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: Sometimes it really is all about the journey! What kind of adventure will you choose? We know just where to take you to see dolphins and other wildlife. And our knowledgeable captains make it an interesting and educational experience for all ages. If it’s all about taking in the sunset for you, just pick your vessel

includes: Life jackets for everyone on board (not required to wear except on 6 passenger boats)
Restrooms on all vessels except 6 passenger boats
gap: Duration of each cruise not stated
blurb: Captiva Cruises operates from Captiva Island, Florida, taking guests on day cruises to nearby barrier islands such as Cabbage Key and Useppa Island. Their fleet includes the 148 passenger Lady Chadwick and 49 passenger motorized catamarans Playtime and Santiva. Cruises are rain or shine if conditions are safe, and all boats have some coverage and restrooms except the 6-passenger boats.
tags: Lunch Cruise to Cabbage Key or Useppa Island
extraNote: Reservations require credit card payment at time of booking; no cash on arrival · Reservations are non-refundable and non-transferable if cancelled within 24 hours of departure; $5 cancellation fee applies if cancelled outside 24 hours · Cruises operate rain or shine if conditions are safe; captain may cancel for safety · Check in at the Captiva Cruises office prior to boarding
